name: Yarn Structure and Characterization
description: Basic characteristics of single fiber, fiber blend and yarn; theoretical and practical determination of fiber packing and fiber directional arrangements in yarns; helical model of fibers in yarns; determination of yarn count and yarn twist; radial migration of fibers in yarns; mass irregularity of yarns; yarn imperfections; theoretical and practical determination of yarn diameter and hairiness; determination of yarn tensile properties; tensile mechanics of fiber bundles and yarns; structures and failure mechanisms of different technological yarns.
